features: 8 hot-swappable removable bays, up to 144TB (8 x 18TB)
RAID 5 / 6 storage support (Windows OS models only); add-on NVR-2U-96CH-RAID5-KIT (min 3 HDD) and NVR-2U-96CH-RAID6-KIT (min 4 HDD)
USB: front 1 x USB 3.0, rear 4 x USB 3.0; 1 x RS-232
Windows 11 IoT LTSC (24H2) or Debian 11 GNU/Linux (-LINUX); VIGIL VMS v7.5+ (Windows), v12.60.0400+ (Linux)
Supported video codecs: MJPEG, MPEG-4, H.264, H.264+, H.265
IP PTZ support; multi-streaming support; IP audio support
Recording modes: motion, alarm, audio, analytics; audio OggVorbis 16 Kbps
Edge-based analytics: people counting, tripwire, loitering alarms
Third-party integrations: access control, alarm, ATM, POS, time/attendance
notes: Storage: datasheet and product page give up to 144TB; sales sheet gives up to 96TB.

Datasheet title mentions hybrid (IP or analog) camera support. Sales sheet gives up to 96 IP channels, "Standard (64 w/32 Hybrid)", and 24 IP or 32 hybrid Flex-Channel licenses; no analog input count is stated.
CPU/RAM: datasheet gives Xeon W-1270E 8-core/16-thread and 32GB RAM; sales sheet gives Xeon 1270E 6-core/12-thread and 16GB RAM; product page gives 16GB RAM.
OS: sales sheet gives Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021.
Datasheet gives weight as 32 lb without HDD and 40 lb with 8 HDD.
